title: ObjectCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for ObjectCOMP, the parent class of Object COMPs, covering local/world transform matrices, Xform and Pre-Xform matrix setters, relative transforms, Alembic and FBX import helpers, and inherited COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs Object COMP transform matrices rather than channel-based Object CHOP output.
Read localTransform for the Object's Xform plus Pre-Xform matrix without parent or constraint transforms, and read worldTransform for the Object's current world transform.
Use transform() and setTransform(matrix) for Xform-page Translate, Rotate, Scale, and Pivot values; use preTransform() and setPreTransform(matrix) for the Pre-Xform page.
Use relativeTransform(target) when code needs the matrix that moves the called ObjectCOMP into the target ObjectCOMP space.

Use importABC() or importFBX() for Alembic or FBX import workflows; review lights, cameras, mergeGeometry, gpuDeform, rate, textureFolder, geometryFolder, and animationFolder options before generating an import plan.
